items.q: When will someone call me back?
a: We call back within 2 hours, every day 7 AM to 10 PM.

items.q: Can I leave my details online?
a: Yes. Answer five short questions on the Talk to us page, and a coordinator calls you back. Nothing is shared until you agree.
aClosed: Not yet. Please call or WhatsApp us on {phone}.

items.q: What happens when you call back?
a: A coordinator talks with you to understand the patient, the home and the doctor's advice. Then we put together a care plan and a quote.

items.q: Will I know the cost before care begins?
a: Yes. You get one care plan and one quote, with a reference number, before you pay.
It depends on the care the patient needs. Your coordinator works it out with you and gives you a quote before you pay.
On the Pay a quote page, with the reference on your quote. You pay against the quote, never before it.
aClosed: Online payment isn’t open yet. To pay for care, call us and a coordinator will help.

items.q: Can I cancel, or get a refund?
a: To be confirmed by the owners (Q8).

items.q: Who do I talk to once care has begun?
a: The Care Setu team. Questions and changes go to us, on {phone}.

items.q: Can I rent equipment, or sell it back?
a: Yes. Rent hospital beds, oxygen concentrators, wheelchairs and monitors, short or long term, delivered and set up at home.
You can also buy equipment outright, or sell it back when you no longer need it, and we collect it from your home.

items.q: How do you check the people who come to our home?
a: Five checks before anyone visits a family: documents, background, a clinical assessment where it applies, a trial and review of first assignments, and continuous monitoring.
